about: The rules for a whole published tree, read by scripts/platform/hygiene-tree.mjs on top of hygiene-rules.json (which still applies to every file; the patterns under inherit.platformPathsOnly apply only under the platform paths). This file is scanned like every other file and passes its own scan: a pattern that would match its own text is written with a one-character class, and internal names are listed only as sha256 under "names" (the plain list is kept outside this repository). "patterns" may skip path globs (`*` stays inside one directory, `**` crosses them). "generated" marks files that are regenerated from their inputs: a hit there is fixed at the input. "shas" accounts for commit ids: pins are allowed by place; digestKeys maps exact case-insensitive content-digest keys to full hexadecimal lengths, never ambiguous revision keys; reviewed commits are allowed by value. "binaries" lists each file that is not UTF-8 text by path and the sha256 of its bytes. "exemptions" lets one line (by the sha256 of its stripped text) of one file hit the listed rules. A malformed entry, or one that matches nothing scanned, is itself a hit.

names.about: Internal names as the sha256 of their lower-case text, each mapped to the rule it fails. The plain list is kept outside this repository; node scripts/platform/hygiene-tree.mjs --names <file> checks the two agree, and node scripts/platform/hygiene-scan.mjs --hash <rule id> <name> prints a new entry.
